rows.text: The party's release dated 'Tuesday, 02 February 2016' is headed 'Press : Members from different communities felicitating BJP National President, Shri Amit Shah at 11, Ashok Road', and its Hindi body says 'भारतीय जनता पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष श्री अमित शाह जी के दोबारा भाजपा अध्यक्ष मनोनीत होने पर आज, मंगलवार को' (today, Tuesday, on BJP National President Shri Amit Shah's being named BJP President again) organisations felicitated him at the central office.
